product_metadata.title: Household Essentials 2026 Pop-Up Collapsible Mesh Laundry Hamper | Black
features: Lightweight, portable pop up hamper with carrying straps
Heavy duty polyester mesh sides allow maximum air circulation
Spring wire frame is easy to collapse for storage
Measures: 16 inches diameter x 25 inches h when open; 16 inches diameter x 1.5 inches h when closed
description: Easy to use and convenient, this pop-up hamper from WHITNEY DESIGN(#2026) can be easily transported from anywhere to the laundry room. It is made from a black polyester mesh which allows for complete air circulation within the hamper. The spring wire frame allows it to "spring" open to a 16" diameter x 25" height size. Carrying straps are located on both sides at the top of the hamper. When not in use, this hamper can be easily collapsed into a 16" diameter disc about 1.5" in height for easy storage.
